'''Stasis block 44''' was a stasis [[Prison/Legends|prison]] vault that was located in the [[Cells of the Lords of the Infinite]] in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Andreaus Thos]] led part of [[Special Operations Group One]] to the stasis block and attempted to free the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] prisoners incarcerated there. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces working with the [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Zale Barrows]] ambushed Thos's group and nearly wiped them out, but the timely arrival of a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] pursuing Barrows turned the tide against the Republic forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stasis block 44 appears as a class-restricted phase on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Bounty Hunter mission "A Thousand Pardons."<ref name="TOR" />
